title: The Fiscal Alibi: Hidden Spending Needs and Government Reputation
abstract: arXiv:2609.25072v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A government may ask for a high tax because it faces a genuine expense. The same demand can also be made by a government that intends to keep the proceeds. We study this ambiguity in a two-period reputation model with privately observed spending needs and an endogenous tax base. The opportunist chooses between outright confiscation and levies that an honest government might impose. We characterize the three possible regimes through a single equilibrium equation. A mean-preserving spread of legitimate needs weakly raises the opportunist's lifetime value, with a strict increase precisely when the spread changes the upper tail relevant for mimicry. We then give a necessary and sufficient curvature condition for this ordering to extend to a general reputational continuation prize. translated_title: 财政借口：隐性支出需求与政府声誉
translated_abstract: 政府可能因面临真实的支出需求而要求征收高税收，但意图侵吞税收收入的政府同样可能提出相同的要求。我们在一个两期声誉模型中研究这种模糊性，其中支出需求仅为政府私人可观察，且税基是内生的。机会主义者在彻底没收与诚实政府可能征收的税收之间进行选择。我们通过单一均衡方程刻画了三种可能的均衡状态。合法支出需求的均值保持展宽会弱性地提高机会主义者的终身价值，且当展宽恰好改变了与模仿相关的上尾部分时，价值严格增加。随后，我们给出了使这一排序能够推广到一般声誉延续奖励的充要曲率条件。核查降低了隐瞒的价值，但同时也改变了机会主义者攫取收入的方式。在基准经济中，更强的审计会弱性地降低当前公民……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文在支出需求为私人信息、税基内生的两期声誉模型中研究政府借真实支出需求之名征税可能掩盖侵吞意图的问题，用单一均衡方程刻画三种均衡状态，证明合法需求的均值保持展宽会弱提高机会主义者的终身价值（当展宽改变与模仿相关的上尾时严格增加），并给出该排序推广到一般声誉奖励的充要曲率条件，同时揭示核查既降低隐瞒价值又改变机会主义者的攫取方式。
en_tdlr: In a two-period reputation model with privately observed spending needs and an endogenous tax base, this paper characterizes three equilibrium regimes via a single equilibrium equation, shows that a mean-preserving spread of legitimate needs weakly raises the opportunist's lifetime value (strictly when it alters the mimicry-relevant upper tail), provides a necessary and sufficient curvature condition for extending this ordering to general reputational prizes, and reveals that verification reduces the value of concealment while changing how the opportunist extracts revenue.
